name: Terminal round-trip
description: Prove deterministic send, submit, viewport readback, and bounded scrollback retrieval.

variants.description: Run nonce-tagged commands in one ephemeral shell and recover both visible and scrolled output.
setup: Generate a unique run ID and nonce and create an empty temporary directory owned by the run.
Capture the baseline Cmux tree and initialize an ownership ledger.
exercise: Create one run-owned workspace, capture its workspace and initial surface refs, and send a command that prints the nonce.
Create exactly 60 nonce-prefixed files, emit one line per file plus a terminal sentinel, and retrieve a bounded scrollback window.

assertions.expectation: The created workspace and surface IDs are present in the ownership ledger and in the live tree.
Viewport readback contains the exact run nonce after send and submit.
Bounded scrollback contains all 60 unique nonce-prefixed filenames and the terminal sentinel.
After cleanup the run-owned workspace is absent and every unrelated baseline resource is unchanged.

cleanup: Close only the recorded run-owned workspace by stable ID.
Delete the temporary directory and compare the post-run Cmux tree with the baseline.
